items.headline: Rays beat Guardians 7-3 in Game 6 to win the AL pennant
items.line: Junior Caminero's first career postseason homer and a Yandy Díaz two-run shot seal it at Tropicana Field. Tampa Bay meets Milwaukee in a World Series that will crown a first-time champion.
items.stat: Freddy Peralta named ALCS MVP · Cleveland's drought hits 78 years

items.headline: Angel Reese drops 30 and 16 as the Dream even the WNBA Finals
items.line: Atlanta wins Game 2 79-65 at Chase Center, closing the third quarter on a 15-2 run. The series heads to Atlanta for Game 3 on Wednesday.
items.thesis: A Finals takeover like this turns Reese from rebounder into the face of a title team.

items.headline: LeBron's 76ers debut comes on the Knicks' banner night at MSG tonight
items.line: New York raises its first championship banner since 1973 before tip-off, then opens its title defense against a Philadelphia side debuting LeBron James and Jaylen Brown.

items.headline: Malik Mustapha jars a 4th-down end-zone ball loose as 49ers hold off Commanders
items.line: San Francisco led 20-3 at half, then survived a Washington comeback. Mustapha forced the ball out from Treylon Burks with 1:54 left and a sack ended it.

items.headline: Dejan Kulusevski returns after 526 days as Spurs finally win
items.line: Tottenham beat Coventry 3-1 for their first league win of the season. Roberto De Zerbi said he brought Kulusevski on for the supporters.
items.stat: Off the bench late after 526 days out · Spurs up to 16th

items.headline: Tennessee AD lights a cigar on the field as Vols' Alabama upset costs $500K
items.line: Fans stormed Neyland Stadium after a 26-10 win over Alabama, sealed by an end-zone interception. Danny White celebrated with a victory cigar amid the crowd.
items.stat: $500,000 SEC field-storming fine · Final pass picked off in end zone

items.headline: Arda Güler scores a rocket and dodges a red as Madrid beat Sevilla 4-1
items.line: Sevilla say Güler struck Peque off the ball before his 30th-minute opener. Juan Iglesias: "I think there was an act of aggression." VAR stayed out a week before the Clásico.
items.stat: Mbappé scores twice · Clásico at Barcelona Oct 25

items.headline: Packers pick off Dak twice inside their 30 and beat Dallas 23-13 on SNF
items.line: Evan Williams and Brandon Cisse intercept Prescott, and Dallas is shut out in a first half for the first time since November 2021. Brian Schottenheimer: "We're in a hole."
items.stat: GB 14 or fewer allowed 3 straight · 22 total penalties

items.headline: Kirill Kaprizov becomes the fastest Wild player to 10 goals
items.line: His short-side snipe past Cam Talbot is the winner in a 2-1 win over Columbus, needing nine games to beat Brian Rolston's old mark of 12.
items.stat: NHL-leading 10 goals in 9 games · 78th career GWG, 3rd in Wild history
